name: config-expression-previews
goal: Show committed regex and computed config expressions inline with ellipsis, preserving structured inspection and source safety.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Committed regex and expression prefixes stay inline with one-line ellipsis and full-source hover; collections keep their inspector. No config evaluation.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The groups matrix deliberately expected a modal for long computed source and lacked a long regex. Extend its typed fixtures and shared assertions at current and historical revisions across all declared viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record673cec617d retains failing inline-expression assertions at b560bea31, all three viewports and both synthetic revisions. Originals reopened from evidence Git;608 red/green image bindings hash-checked,168 unique images decoded and12 relevant originals inspected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit c546723d0 limits inspection marks to static collections and shows expression source as one ellipsized line with full-source title. Daniel explicitly authorized application and browser verification while automated proof was queued.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record acb9979ae0 passes the same16 unchanged tests, inputs, assertions and profile78e814b3 as RED673cec617d. Collection keyboard inspection, escaped source, short/long/multiline values, revision boundaries and table word geometry pass. Broader integration verification remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
